selection.rule.define.summary: Define a versioned, project/document-owned native entity selection rule and persist its manifest in the shared artifact store.

inputs.query: Existing entity.find query filters with explicit kind, expected cardinality, and explicit component/occurrence/body/feature or instances:true scope. unique is not supported. The manifest pins project, saved document version and instance scope.
inputs.exclude: Optional array of at most 64 entity.find filter objects, evaluated in the same kind/frame/instance scope before checking final expected cardinality.

limitations: A definition is accepted only when the current native query and exclusions satisfy expected cardinality.
The result includes an opaque ArtifactStore reference; retain it for later inspect/resolve/check calls.
Native Fusion qualification has not been performed. Offline fake-backend tests do not establish native topology or restore behavior.

selection.rule.inspect.summary: Load an owned selection rule artifact and inspect its version, scope and resolver provenance without querying current topology.

inputs.artifact: Opaque version-1 artifact reference returned by selection.rule.define or a successful resolve/check; it is bound to the exact project and DataFile ID.

limitations: The exact --doc-file-id pin must match the stored DataFile; project/document ownership and artifact hash are checked before return.
Inspection does not re-run predicates or validate current topology.

selection.rule.resolve.summary: Re-run a persisted selection rule against current native topology and report resolved, split, merge, missing, stale or ambiguous status.

inputs.artifact: Opaque version-1 artifact reference returned by selection.rule.define or a successful resolve/check.

limitations: A changed saved source version is stale even if predicates still match; failed or changed-topology results do not advance the stored baseline.
Historical native references are provenance only. The operation re-runs entity.find and never chooses a first result or repairs a stale reference.
The exact --doc-file-id pin, stored project/document owner, and artifact hash are checked before native dispatch.

selection.rule.check.summary: Require a persisted selection rule to resolve unambiguously with its expected cardinality and unchanged saved source version.

inputs.artifact: Opaque version-1 artifact reference returned by selection.rule.define or a successful resolve/check.

limitations: Only resolved status with the full expected cardinality passes. Split, merge, missing, stale and ambiguous remain failures.
No native Fusion qualification or physical CAD acceptance is implied.
